title: Predicted structure of zebrafish Shha signalling domain (Boltz-2 + MSA): a computed model, not an observation
evidence_kind: PREDICTED: a computed structure hypothesis, not an observed structure

model.name: Boltz-2 (Nebius Scientific AI MCP boltz2_predict_native), 3 diffusion samples, PDB70 MMseqs2 MSA
model.context: Shha (UniProt Q92008) residues 24-197, the mature N-terminal signalling fragment.

numerical_checks.name: same residues in the earlier OpenFold2 dummy-MSA prediction

parameter_unknowns: pLDDT/pTM are model-internal confidence, not a calibrated probability of correctness.
open_questions: Does a holo model with Zn2+/Ca2+ and the cholesterol-modified C terminus change the surface used by Ptch/Hhip?
limitations: MSA is PDB70-only (structural database, 14-122 sequences), so homologous crystal structures may be templated.
No seed accepted by the runtime; diffusion sampling is nondeterministic.
